text.tr: `input()` her zaman hangi türde değer döndürür?
text.en: What type of value does `input()` always return?

en: `int` or `str` depending on what was typed

explanation.en: If you need a number, `int(input(...))` or `float(input(...))`.

text.en: What does `print("a", "b", sep="-")` print?

explanation.en: `sep` goes between the arguments, `end` at the very end.

text.en: What does `f"{3.14159:.2f}"` give?

explanation.en: `:.2f` means two digits after the point, rounded.

text.en: With `def hello(to="world"):`, what is `to` in the call `hello()`?

explanation.en: When no argument is given, the default value is used.

text.tr: `if name == "Harry" or "Hermione":` neden her zaman doğrudur?
text.en: Why is `if name == "Harry" or "Hermione":` always true?

tr: `"Hermione"` tek başına boş olmayan bir dize, yani doğru
en: `"Hermione"` on its own is a non-empty string, so it is true

explanation.tr: Doğrusu `name == "Harry" or name == "Hermione"` ya da `name in ["Harry", "Hermione"]`.
explanation.en: The right way is `name == "Harry" or name == "Hermione"`, or `name in ["Harry", "Hermione"]`.

text.tr: Bir sayının çift olduğu nasıl denetlenir?
text.en: How do you check that a number is even?

explanation.en: `%` gives the remainder of a division.

text.tr: Art arda `if` yerine `elif` yazmanın farkı ne?
text.en: What is the difference between writing `elif` instead of consecutive `if`s?

en: `elif` is checked only if the earlier conditions were false

explanation.tr: Bir koşul tutunca kalan `elif`'ler atlanır; gereksiz soru sorulmaz.
explanation.en: Once one condition holds, the remaining `elif`s are skipped; no needless questions are asked.

text.en: What does `case _:` mean inside a `match`?

en: The case that runs if no other `case` matches

explanation.en: Like the `else` of an `if`/`elif` chain.

text.tr: `for i in range(3):` `i`'ye hangi değerleri verir?
text.en: Which values does `for i in range(3):` give `i`?

explanation.en: `range(n)` starts at zero and does not include `n`.

text.tr: Bir sözlüğün üzerinde `for x in students:` her turda `x`'e ne verir?
text.en: What does `for x in students:` give `x` on each pass when `students` is a dictionary?

explanation.en: The value with `students[x]`; both with `students.items()`.

text.en: How do you leave a `while True:` loop?

explanation.tr: Kullanıcıdan geçerli değer alana kadar sormak için sık kullanılan kalıp.
explanation.en: A common pattern for asking the user until a valid value comes.

text.en: With `students = ["Hermione", "Harry"]`, what is `students[-1]`?

explanation.en: A negative index counts from the end.

text.en: What happens with `int("cat")`?

explanation.tr: Dize sayıya çevrilemiyorsa `ValueError`; `try`/`except ValueError` ile yakalanır.
explanation.en: If the string can't be converted, a `ValueError`; caught with `try`/`except ValueError`.

text.en: When does the `else` in a `try` ... `except` ... `else:` block run?

explanation.tr: `try`'a yalnızca hata verebilecek satırı koyup kalanını `else`'e almak için.
explanation.en: So that only the line that can fail goes in `try` and the rest goes in `else`.

text.en: What does `except ValueError: pass` do?

tr: Hatayı yakalar ve hiçbir şey yapmadan devam eder
en: Catches the error and carries on without doing anything

explanation.tr: Bir döngüde "geçersizse yeniden sor" için işe yarar.
explanation.en: Useful in a loop for "if invalid, ask again".

text.en: What does `raise ValueError("Invalid house")` do?

tr: Bir hata yükseltir; çağıran kod `except` ile yakalayabilir
en: Raises an error; the calling code can catch it with `except`
Assigns an error to a variable

explanation.tr: Kendi fonksiyonunda geçersiz girdiyi bildirmenin yolu.
explanation.en: The way to report invalid input from your own function.

text.tr: `from random import choice` sonrasında doğru çağrı hangisi?
text.en: After `from random import choice`, which call is right?

explanation.tr: `from ... import` adı doğrudan getirir; `random` adı tanımlanmaz.
explanation.en: `from ... import` brings the name in directly; the name `random` is not defined.

text.en: When `python name.py David` runs, what is `sys.argv[1]`?

explanation.en: `sys.argv[0]` is the program's name.

text.en: What does `sys.exit("Too few arguments")` do?

tr: İletiyi yazar ve programı 1 çıkış koduyla bitirir
en: Prints the message and ends the program with exit code 1
Raises an error and carries on

explanation.tr: 0 "başarılı", sıfırdan farklı kodlar "bir sorun oldu" demek.
explanation.en: 0 means "success", non-zero codes "something went wrong".

text.en: What does `pip install cowsay` do?

en: Downloads and installs the `cowsay` package from PyPI
Opens a module from the standard library

explanation.en: Then it is used with `import cowsay`.

text.tr: pytest hangi fonksiyonları test olarak çalıştırır?
text.en: Which functions does pytest run as tests?

explanation.en: The file's name starts with `test_` too: `test_calculator.py`.

text.en: What happens if `assert square(2) == 4` is false?

explanation.tr: pytest bu hatayı yakalayıp testi "düştü" diye raporlar.
explanation.en: pytest catches this error and reports the test as failed.

text.tr: Bir fonksiyonun hata verdiğini pytest'te nasıl sınarsın?
text.en: How do you test in pytest that a function raises an error?

en: By calling it inside a `with pytest.raises(ValueError):` block

explanation.en: If no error comes out of the block, the test fails.

text.tr: Test edilecek fonksiyon neden yazdırmak yerine değer döndürmeli?
text.en: Why should a function under test return a value instead of printing?

tr: Dönen değer `assert` ile karşılaştırılabilir; ekrana yazılan karşılaştırılamaz
en: A returned value can be compared with `assert`; what is printed can't

explanation.en: Leave the printing to `main`.

text.en: How does `open("names.txt", "a")` open the file?

en: For writing from scratch, erasing what was there

explanation.en: `"w"` empties the file, `"a"` keeps it.

text.en: What does `with open(...) as file:` take care of?

en: Closes the file automatically when the block ends

explanation.en: It is closed even if an error happens.

text.en: How does `csv.DictReader` give each row?

tr: Başlık satırındaki adları anahtar olarak kullanan bir sözlük
en: As a dictionary using the names in the header row as keys

explanation.tr: `row["name"]`; sütunların sırası değişse de kod çalışır.
explanation.en: `row["name"]`; the code works even if the columns change order.

text.en: Why write `line.rstrip()` on a line read from a file?

tr: Satırın sonundaki satır sonunu (`\n`) atmak için
en: To remove the newline (`\n`) at the end of the line
To turn the line into a number

explanation.tr: Yoksa `print` kendi satır sonunu da ekler ve boş satırlar çıkar.
explanation.en: Otherwise `print` adds its own newline too and empty lines appear.

text.en: What do `^` and `$` do in `re.search(r"^\w+@\w+\.edu$", email)`?

tr: Kalıbın metnin başından sonuna kadar tutmasını şart koşar
en: They require the pattern to match from the start of the text to its end
They turn the text into uppercase

explanation.en: Without them, `malan@harvard.edu.com` would match too.

text.en: Why write `\.` in a regular expression?

tr: `.` tek başına her karakterle eşleştiği için gerçek noktayı aramak
en: Because `.` alone matches any character, to look for an actual dot

explanation.tr: Kalıbı ham dize `r"..."` olarak yaz ki ters bölü Python'da kaybolmasın.
explanation.en: Write the pattern as a raw string `r"..."` so Python does not eat the backslash.

text.en: What does `re.search(pattern, s, re.IGNORECASE)` change?

en: It matches regardless of uppercase or lowercase
It only looks at the first letter

explanation.en: Otherwise `@HARVARD.EDU` would not match.

text.en: After `matches = re.search(r"^(\w+), (\w+)$", name)`, what is `matches.group(2)`?

en: The text captured by the second parentheses
The text captured by the first parentheses

explanation.en: `group(0)` is the whole match; if it fails, `re.search` returns `None`.

text.en: What is `self`, the first parameter of `__init__`?

en: The object that was just created

explanation.en: It is not passed when calling; Python passes it.

text.en: What do `@property` and its setter make possible?

en: Running a check on every assignment to the attribute

explanation.en: The value is stored under a different name, `self._house`.

text.en: How is a method written with `@classmethod` called?

en: Without creating an object, through the class's name: `Hat.sort("Harry")`

explanation.en: Its first parameter is the class itself, `cls`.

text.en: What does `super().__init__(name)` do inside `class Student(Wizard):`?

explanation.tr: Ortak iş (adı denetleyip saklamak) tek yerde kalır.
explanation.en: The shared work (checking and storing the name) stays in one place.

text.tr: `set()` ile kurulan kümeye aynı değer iki kez eklenirse?
text.en: If the same value is added twice to a set made with `set()`?

en: It appears in the set once

explanation.tr: Kümenin sırası yok; sıralı çıktı için `sorted`.
explanation.en: A set has no order; for sorted output, `sorted`.

text.en: With `def f(*args):`, what is `args` in the call `f(1, 2, 3)`?

explanation.en: Positional arguments are gathered in a tuple.

text.tr: `[s["name"] for s in students if s["house"] == "Gryffindor"]` ne kurar?
text.en: What does `[s["name"] for s in students if s["house"] == "Gryffindor"]` build?

tr: Yalnızca Gryffindor'lu öğrencilerin adlarından bir liste
en: A list of the names of only the Gryffindor students
A list of all the names

explanation.en: The `if` at the end of the comprehension works like a filter.

text.tr: `yield` kullanan bir fonksiyon neden çok büyük veride de belleği doldurmaz?
text.en: Why does a function using `yield` not fill up memory even with very large data?

tr: Değerleri birer birer verir; hepsini aynı anda tutmaz
en: It hands out values one at a time; it does not hold them all at once

explanation.tr: Bir sonraki değer istenene kadar fonksiyon durur ve yerini hatırlar.
explanation.en: The function pauses and remembers its place until the next value is asked for.
